_comment: Campaign template. Copy it to providers.local.json (gitignored) before touching it.
No API key must appear in THIS file: it is versioned.
Always prefer apiKeyEnv (the name of an environment variable) over apiKey (a plain-text value).

ollama._comment: Zero cost. Run it first: it validates the kit end to end without spending a single credit.

anthropic._comment: Identity-linked key? Add workspaceId (wrkspc_…) — the API rejects every request without it. Classic keys do not need it.

azure._comment: Azure serves deployments, not a catalogue: the wildcard does not apply, declare them here.

kimi._comment: International endpoint by default. Mainland China account: baseUrl https://api.moonshot.cn/v1.

mistral._comment: Run WITHOUT baseUrl: that is how G-14 is verified closed against the real API.

minimax._comment: Campaign 2026-08-30: 7 modes green on MiniMax-M2 (the red ones are on the model's side). Mainland endpoint: baseUrl https://api.minimaxi.com/v1.

gemini._comment: Google's OpenAI compatibility endpoint, not Vertex AI. M8 is fully exercised there since 2026-08-30 (json_object and json_schema accepted, schema validated server-side).
